<h1 id="wpf治具软件模板分享">WPF治具软件模板分享</h1>
<p><strong>运行环境：VS2022   .NET 8.0</strong><br>
<strong>完整项目：<a href="https://gitee.com/dragonet-Z/Jig_SoftTemplate" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Gitee仓库</a></strong><br>
<strong>项目重命名方法参考：<a href="https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/642365396" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">网页</a></strong></p>
<blockquote>
<p><strong>概要</strong>：针对<strong>治具单机软件</strong>制作了一个设计模板，此项目可对一些治具的PC简易软件项目提供一个软件模板，可以通过修改项目名快速开发，本项目使用了<strong>CommunityToolkit.Mvvm</strong>来搭建MVVM框架，使用了<strong>Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection</strong>来实现DI依赖注入实现IOC，并使用了<strong>WPFUI</strong>作为UI框架 这个项目可以通过重命名修改成自己所需的软件项目，实现减少重复创建框架的目的 此项目还有很多不足，望大家多多谅解！</p>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2 id="程序功能介绍">程序功能介绍</h2>
<p>此程序适用于治具的PC简易软件的快速开发，软件各个功能实现如下：<br>
MVVM框架：CommunityToolkit.Mvvm库<br>
DI依赖注入：Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection<br>
UI框架：WPFUI库<br>
程序日志：NLog库<br>
程序配置：System.Text.Json库<br>
多语言支持：resx资源文件+WPFLocalizeExtension库</p>
<p>软件文件架构如下图所示<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2368008/202509/2368008-20250921231028078-1655810016.png" alt="图片1" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="功能实现">功能实现</h2>
<h3 id="导航功能">导航功能</h3>
<ul>
<li>App.xaml.cs</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-CSharp">var container = new ServiceCollection();

//...

//注册导航服务
container.AddSingleton&lt;Common.Services.NavigationService&gt;();

//...

Services = container.BuildServiceProvider();
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>MainWindow.xaml</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;Grid&gt;
    &lt;Grid.RowDefinitions&gt;
        &lt;RowDefinition Height="50"/&gt;
        &lt;RowDefinition/&gt;
    &lt;/Grid.RowDefinitions&gt;

    &lt;Grid&gt;
        &lt;ui:TitleBar Title="JIG_SoftTemplate_V1.0.0" Background="#e5e5e5"&gt;
            &lt;ui:TitleBar.Icon&gt;
                &lt;ui:ImageIcon Source="/Resources/Image/Company_logo.png"/&gt;
            &lt;/ui:TitleBar.Icon&gt;
        &lt;/ui:TitleBar&gt;
    &lt;/Grid&gt;

    &lt;Grid Grid.Row="1" x:Name="ShowGrid"&gt;
        &lt;Frame x:Name="rootFrame"/&gt;
        &lt;ui:SnackbarPresenter x:Name="rootSnackbarPresenter" Margin="0,0,0,-15"/&gt;
        &lt;ContentPresenter x:Name="rootContentDialog"/&gt;
    &lt;/Grid&gt;
&lt;/Grid&gt;
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>MainWindow.xaml.cs</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-CSharp">public partial class MainWindow
{
    public MainWindow(MainWindowViewModel viewModel, Common.Services.NavigationService navigationService)
    {
        InitializeComponent();

        DataContext = viewModel;

        navigationService.SetMainFrame(rootFrame);

        App.Current.Services.GetRequiredService&lt;ISnackbarService&gt;().SetSnackbarPresenter(rootSnackbarPresenter);
        App.Current.Services.GetRequiredService&lt;IContentDialogService&gt;().SetDialogHost(rootContentDialog);


    }
}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>NavigationService.cs</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-CSharp">public class NavigationService
{
    private Frame? mainFrame;

    public void SetMainFrame(Frame frame) =&gt; mainFrame = frame;

    private Type? FindView&lt;VM&gt;()
    {
        return Assembly
            .GetAssembly(typeof(VM))
            ?.GetTypes()
            .FirstOrDefault(t =&gt; t.Name == typeof(VM).Name.Replace("ViewModel", ""));
    }

    public void Navigate&lt;VM&gt;()
        where VM : ViewModelBase
    {
        Navigate&lt;VM&gt;(null);
    }

    public void Navigate&lt;VM&gt;(Dictionary&lt;string, object?&gt;? extraData)
        where VM : ViewModelBase
    {
        var viewType = FindView&lt;VM&gt;();
        if (viewType is null)
            return;

        var page = App.Current.Services.GetService(viewType) as Page;
        mainFrame?.Navigate(page, extraData);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>在MainWindow.xaml里放Frame控件，在MainWindow.xaml.cs里，调用NavigationService的SetMainFrame方法设定了Frame组件实例，然后在VM中调用Navigate方法即可跳转页面，示例：<code>navigationService.Navigate&lt;HomePageViewModel&gt;();</code></p>
<blockquote>
<p>需注意，View和ViewModel需要名称对的上，如NavigationService.cs中所示，比如<code>HomePage.xaml</code>的ViewModel就是<code>HomePageViewModel</code>，名称错误的话，会在FindView方法中报错</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="程序配置">程序配置</h3>
<ul>
<li>App.xaml.cs</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-CSharp">var container = new ServiceCollection();

//...

//注册Json配置文件服务
container.AddSingleton&lt;Common.Services.JsonConfigService&gt;();

//...

Services = container.BuildServiceProvider();
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>AppConfigModel.cs</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-CSharp">public class AppConfigModel
{
    public CommonConfig? Common {  get; set; }

    public JIGCommConfig? JIGComm { get; set; }
}

public class CommonConfig
{
    public string? DataStoragePath { get; set; }
    public string? SelectedLang { get; set; }
}

public class JIGCommConfig
{

}
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>JsonConfigService.cs</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-CSharp">public class JsonConfigService
{
    private const string ConfigFileName = "AppSettings.json";

    private readonly LoggerService loggerService;

    public JsonConfigService(LoggerService loggerService)
    {
        this.loggerService = loggerService;
    }

    public async Task&lt;T&gt; LoadConfigAsync&lt;T&gt;(T defaultValue = default) where T : new()
    {
        try
        {
            var filePath = GetConfigFilePath();
            if (!File.Exists(filePath))
            {
                loggerService.Info("配置文件不存在，返回默认值");
                await SaveConfigAsync(defaultValue ?? new T());
                return defaultValue ?? new T();
            }

            await using var fs = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
            return await JsonSerializer.DeserializeAsync&lt;T&gt;(fs) ?? new T();
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            loggerService.Error("加载配置文件失败", ex);
            return defaultValue ?? new T();
        }
    }

    public async Task SaveConfigAsync&lt;T&gt;(T config)
    {
        try
        {
            var filePath = GetConfigFilePath();
            var dirPath = Path.GetDirectoryName(filePath);

            if (!Directory.Exists(dirPath))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(dirPath);
            }

            var options = new JsonSerializerOptions
            {
                WriteIndented = true,
                Encoder = System.Text.Encodings.Web.JavaScriptEncoder.UnsafeRelaxedJsonEscaping
            };

            await using var fs = new FileStream(filePath, FileMode.Create, FileAccess.Write);
            await JsonSerializer.SerializeAsync(fs, config, options);
            loggerService.Info("配置文件保存成功");
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            loggerService.Error("保存配置文件失败", ex);
            throw;
        }
    }

    private static string GetConfigFilePath()
    {
        // 使用程序根目录存储配置文件
        return Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, ConfigFileName);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>调用服务时，只需调用<code>LoadConfigAsync</code>和<code>SaveConfigAsync</code>异步方法即可，示例如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-CSharp">//读取配置文件
string DataStoragePath = "";

var loadedConfig = await jsonConfigService.LoadConfigAsync(new AppConfigModel());
if (loadedConfig != null)
{
    if (loadedConfig?.Common != null)
    {
        //更新到属性
        DataStoragePath = loadedConfig.Common.DataStoragePath;
    }
}

//保存配置到文件
private AppConfigModel appConfig;
//初始化appConfig
appConfig = new AppConfigModel();
appConfig.Common = new CommonConfig();

//更新界面上数据到配置appConfig中
appConfig.Common.DataStoragePath = DataStoragePath;

//保存配置
await jsonConfigService.SaveConfigAsync(appConfig);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="日志功能">日志功能</h3>
<ul>
<li>App.xaml.cs</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-CSharp">var container = new ServiceCollection();

//...

//注册日志服务
container.AddSingleton&lt;Common.Services.LoggerService&gt;();

//...

Services = container.BuildServiceProvider();
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>NLog.config</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8" ?&gt;
&lt;nlog xmlns="http://www.nlog-project.org/schemas/NLog.xsd"
      xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
      autoReload="true"&gt;

	&lt;targets&gt;
		&lt;!-- Info日志目标 --&gt;
		&lt;target name="InfoFile"
				xsi:type="File"
				fileName="LogFile/LogInfo/${shortdate}-Info.log"
				layout="${date:format=yyyy-MM-dd HH\:mm\:ss.fff} [INFO] ${message}${newline}"
				encoding="UTF-8"
				archiveEvery="Day"
				maxArchiveFiles="100"
				concurrentWrites="true"
				keepFileOpen="false"/&gt;

		&lt;!-- Error日志目标 --&gt;
		&lt;target name="ErrorFile"
				xsi:type="File"
				fileName="LogFile/LogError/${shortdate}-Error.log"
				layout="${date:format=yyyy-MM-dd HH\:mm\:ss.fff} [ERROR] [ThreadID:${threadid}] ${message}${newline}[StackTrace:${exception:format=Message}]${newline}"
				encoding="UTF-8"
				archiveEvery="Day"
				maxArchiveFiles="100"
				concurrentWrites="true"
				keepFileOpen="false"/&gt;
	&lt;/targets&gt;

	&lt;rules&gt;
		&lt;!-- MyLog记录器规则 --&gt;
		&lt;logger name="MyLog" minlevel="Info" maxlevel="Info" writeTo="InfoFile" final="true" /&gt;
		&lt;logger name="MyLog" minlevel="Error" maxlevel="Error" writeTo="ErrorFile" final="true" /&gt;
	&lt;/rules&gt;
&lt;/nlog&gt;
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>LoggerService.cs</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-CSharp">public class LoggerService
{
    private static readonly NLog.ILogger Logger = NLog.LogManager.GetLogger("MyLog");

    public void Info(string message)
    {
        Logger.Info(message);
    }

    public void Error(string message, Exception? ex = null)
    {
        Logger.Error(ex, message);
    }
}
</code></pre>
<p>调用服务时，只需调用<code>Info</code>和<code>Error</code>方法即可，示例如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-CSharp">private void FunA()
{
    try
    {
        loggerService.Info("程序成功");
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        loggerService.Error("程序出错", ex);
    }
}
</code></pre>
